# sbx-browser

> Task-oriented orchestration for coding-agent CLIs on your own Modal workspace. Use an existing SBX with only a base URL + API key, or self-host with `./sbx deploy`.

## Start

- [Introduction](/getting-started/introduction/): product model and deployment boundary
- [Quick start](/getting-started/quick-start/): existing deployment and fresh self-host paths
- [Core concepts](/concepts/): Task, Run, Revision, Delivery, Review and Integrations

## Use SBX

- [Tasks](/guides/tasks/): create, monitor, follow up, cancel and retry
- [Repositories and delivery](/guides/repositories/): revisions, branches, pull requests, review-gated merge
- [Streaming](/guides/streaming/): SSE and reconnect
- [Recovery](/guides/recovery/): recover after disconnects and uncertain mutations
- [Examples](/guides/examples/): canonical executable SDK examples
